name: Frong
description: For my personal take on "Pong," I went for a more chaotic party game. First to 7 wins!
contribution: Developed a dynamic music system that fades certain tracks in or out depending on the situation
Created highly maluable dev tools so I didn't have to re design the entire game whenever I added a new ability
notes: This game is the second entry in my minigames' collection
I am super proud of the music engine used in this game. In fact this game was on the chopping block for exhibits here before I remembered it's existence.
Because of this games two-player nature I ended up playing this with my roommate a fair bit over the course of it's development
The term 'Frong' is a portmanteau of 'Frog' and 'Pong'
